verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document spreading traffic across multiple keys, or queuing or throttling requests to stay under provider rate limits. What it does document is adjacent: fallback to a different model after a rate-limit failure, weighted load balancing across models (not keys), BYOK, and monthly spend caps per key. These are related features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can smooth provider rate limits by spreading traffic across keys and queuing or throttling requests
